name: RemoteProcedureInvocation
summary: Has services collaborate by request and reply over a network protocol, so that a caller gets its answer at once and is unavailable for as long as the service it called is.

roles.name: Service
roles.summary: The participant that exposes a request/reply API to other services. Its availability becomes theirs for the duration of every call, and its signature says nothing about that.

roles.name: Client
roles.summary: The participant that calls it. It cannot answer while the service cannot, and it has to find the service before it can call it at all — which is why this is the role a circuit breaker and a discovery mechanism attach to.
